observations: Significant improvements were observed from the blinded baseline to the unblinded 6-month wear period in percent TIR(70-180 mg/dL), percent time in hyperglycemia(> 180 and > 250 mg/dL), mean EGV and GMI.

The unblinded 6-month wear period showed a significant improvement compared to the blinded baseline period in percent TIR(41.9??5.5%, p = 0.001), percent time > 180 mg/dL(58??4.3%, p = 0.001), percent time > 250 mg/dL(23.1??0.1%, p = 0.002), EGV(205 mg/dL to 172 mg/dL, p < 0.001) and GMI(8.2??.4%, p < 0.001).
There was little time spent in hypoglycemia during all CGM study periods.
No adverse events related to the intervention were reported during this study.
